workspace.noProjects: No projects in this workspace yet

agent-team.name: Agent Team
agent-team.description: Adds a task to the assigned squad and starts a team run.

github-loop.name: GitHub issue loop
github-loop.description: Clones the bound repository, lets an agent work the linked GitHub issue, pushes a branch and opens a pull request.
